title: 把远程会议邀请写清楚，并落下下一步
topic: 把远程会议邀请写清楚，并落下下一步

source.title: Run effective meetings - Dropbox Virtual First Communication Kit
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 本课按 Dropbox 官方虚拟会议指南的步骤 1–3 和 7，练习判断是否开会、写清邀请、筛选参会者，并在会后落实决定和负责人。
paragraphs: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion. If you’re giving a status update or just have a quick question, try to handle it asynchronously. Check out Meetings 101 to learn more.

Effective meetings have a clear goal, a short list of things to cover, and the right mix of attendees. If you decide to have a meeting, fill out the meeting prep worksheet below. When you’re done, double-check: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there, or could they get the notes via email later?

In your invite, briefly summarize your points from the meeting prep worksheet above. If you’re working with people who like to prepare in advance, or if you’re trying to gather feedback asynchronously before the meeting, be sure to include reference docs with clear instructions. Is your invite too wordy? Try cutting it by half. Bonus points for including one of the 3d’s in your meeting title (ex: product design decision, team goals discussion, product roadmap debate).

When the meeting’s over, thank everyone for their time. Then quickly summarize the decision you made, what happens next, and who will do what. Have a notetaker prep a short recap and send it after. Bonus points for ending five minutes early, so people have more time to recharge.
translations: 在你习惯性地安排线上会议之前，先确认这场会是否用于 3D：重要决策、辩论或讨论。如果只是状态更新或一个简单问题，尽量异步处理。
有效的会议有明确目标、简短的讨论清单和合适的参会者组合。如果决定开会，就填写会议准备表；完成后再检查议程上的每个人是否都必须参加，还是可以会后通过邮件收到记录。
在邀请中简要概括会议准备表里的要点。如果参会者需要提前准备，或你想在会前异步收集反馈，就附上参考资料并写清楚说明。邀请太长吗？试着删减一半；也可以在会议标题中点明决策、讨论或辩论主题。
会议结束时，感谢大家，然后简要总结作出的决定、后续安排和各自负责人。请记录人准备并发送简短纪要；条件允许时，提前五分钟结束，让大家有时间休息。
fullTextParagraphs: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion. If you’re giving a status update or just have a quick question, try to handle it asynchronously. Check out Meetings 101 to learn more.

Effective meetings have a clear goal, a short list of things to cover, and the right mix of attendees. If you decide to have a meeting, fill out the meeting prep worksheet below. When you’re done, double-check: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there, or could they get the notes via email later?

In your invite, briefly summarize your points from the meeting prep worksheet above. If you’re working with people who like to prepare in advance, or if you’re trying to gather feedback asynchronously before the meeting, be sure to include reference docs with clear instructions. Is your invite too wordy? Try cutting it by half. Bonus points for including one of the 3d’s in your meeting title (ex: product design decision, team goals discussion, product roadmap debate).

Once the meeting is on the calendar, help get everyone—including yourself—ready. Your meeting will run more smoothly if the team is prepped and ready for the discussion. Read and share any relevant content beforehand so everyone has the same context. Make sure everyone has done their pre-meeting work. Send a friendly reminder if necessary. If you’d like anyone to share their screen, let them know ahead of time so they have the right documents handy. Think about the tone you’d like to set. For example, a team-building meeting should feel light and fun, whereas a check on well-being should feel safe and supportive.

If you called the meeting, take advice from The Art of Gathering author Priya Parker and act as a gracious, authoritative host—someone who’s welcoming and warm yet confidently in charge. When your meeting starts: Leave time for unscripted chitchat. If your team members are remote, chances are they miss making impromptu connections. Warmly welcome everyone by their first name. If people don’t know each other, ask them to introduce themselves. Awkward silence? Try a creative conversation starter. Briefly restate your goal and agenda, and what happened the last time you met. If needed, give people a short “study hall” at the beginning to review reference docs. Encourage honesty and candor by creating a safe and confidential place for people to feel comfortable sharing their thoughts and ideas.

When we’re videoconferencing, it’s easy to space out or interrupt while someone else is talking. No matter your role, you can help ensure that all voices—not just the loudest—are heard in your meeting. Try to: Explicitly say you’d like to hear everyone’s perspective. Redirect when things go off topic: “JD, I love those ideas but I want to make sure we get through our agenda. Let’s put them in the parking lot.” Interrupt the interrupters: “Thanks, Justin, but I’d like to finish hearing from Eunice. Eunice, can you say more?” Call on quieter people: “I’d love to hear from folks who haven’t spoken yet. Monique, what do you think?”

When the meeting’s over, thank everyone for their time. Then quickly summarize the decision you made, what happens next, and who will do what. Have a notetaker prep a short recap and send it after. Bonus points for ending five minutes early, so people have more time to recharge.

Step 7: Decide on next steps and end early

notes.meaning: 习惯性地安排线上会议
notes.explain: reflexively 描述不经思考就做出的反应；原文建议先判断是否真的需要同步开会。
notes.example: Before we reflexively schedule a call, could we resolve this by email?

notes.explain: 重点是让能提供必要信息或作决定的人参加，不是把所有相关同事都拉进会议。
notes.example: Invite the right mix of attendees to make the decision.

notes.phrase: include reference docs with clear instructions
notes.meaning: 附上参考资料并写清楚准备要求
notes.explain: 参会者需要知道会前读什么、带着什么问题来；材料本身不能替代明确指令。
notes.example: Please include the comparison doc and ask attendees to review the cost column.

notes.phrase: summarize the decision you made, what happens next, and who will do what
notes.meaning: 总结决定、后续安排和负责人
notes.explain: 会后纪要应同时说明结果、下一步和行动负责人，避免只记录讨论过程。
notes.example: We’ll summarize the decision, next steps, and owners in the recap.

scenario.title: Deciding how to improve customer support
english: The support team must decide whether to pilot a chatbot or extend evening coverage. A one-page comparison lists expected costs and response times.
The operations lead will make the decision; the support lead and API analyst can advise. The rest of the department only needs the decision afterward.
Write a concise meeting invitation: state the decision and key question, tell attendees what to review, invite only necessary people, and say the meeting will end with an owner and next step.
chinese: 支持团队需要决定试行聊天机器人，还是延长晚间服务时间。一页对比材料列出了预计成本和响应时间。
运营负责人作决定；支持负责人和 API 分析师提供意见。部门其他成员只需会后收到决定。
写一封简短会议邀请：说明要作出的决定和关键问题，告知参会者要预先查看什么，只邀请必要人员，并说明会议结束时会明确负责人和下一步。

firstAttempt.prompt:
请把下面含糊又拉了全员的邀请改成三句以内：写明要作出的决定、会前阅读材料、需要参会的角色，并说明会后确认负责人和下一步。不得编造材料之外的决定。

Subject: Support meeting
Hi everyone, let’s get together next week to talk about support. I’ll invite the whole department. We can decide what to do when we meet.
firstAttempt.sample:
Subject: Decide how to improve customer support
Hi team, let’s meet to decide whether to pilot a chatbot or extend evening coverage. Please review the one-page cost and response-time comparison beforehand; I’ve invited the operations lead to decide and the support lead and API analyst to advise. We’ll leave with an owner and next step.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先写明确决定，再交代准备材料和必要参会角色，最后说明会后行动；所列决定、材料、角色均来自题面模拟情境。

words.example: We need to make a decision about evening support.
words.translation: 我们需要决定晚间支持方案。
words.note: 本课邀请应明确会议要作出的具体决定。

words.example: Only the required attendees need to join the decision meeting.
words.translation: 只有必要的参会者需要参加决策会议。
words.note: 筛选能提供意见或作决定的人。

words.example: Please read the reference document before the meeting.
words.translation: 请在会前阅读参考文件。
words.note: 邀请中应说明会前材料和准备要求。

words.example: We can handle a quick status update asynchronously.
words.translation: 我们可以异步处理简单的状态更新。
words.note: 不需要所有人同时参与时，可考虑异步沟通。

words.example: We’ll assign an owner for the next step.
words.translation: 我们会为下一步指定负责人。
words.note: 会议结束时明确由谁推进后续工作。

words.example: The agenda lists the decision and the questions to resolve.
words.translation: 议程列出需要作出的决定和待解决的问题。
words.note: 议程应简洁并服务于会议目标。

structure.original: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there, or could they get the notes via email later?
analysis: Does everyone on the agenda really need to be there 是一般疑问句，检查每位列入议程的人是否都需要现场参与。
or 连接另一种安排：could they get the notes via email later，could 表示可行的替代方式。
这句话提醒组织者比较同步参会与会后异步获取记录，避免邀请过多人。
structure.transfer: Could the wider sales team get the decision and recap by email instead of attending the support-tool meeting?

rewrite.bad: Let’s invite the whole department and work out the meeting goal once everyone is there.
rewrite.good:
Subject: Decide how to improve customer support
Hi team, let’s meet to decide whether to pilot a chatbot or extend evening coverage. Please review the one-page cost and response-time comparison beforehand; I’ve invited the operations lead to decide and the support lead and API analyst to advise. We’ll leave with an owner and next step.
rewrite.translation:
主题：决定如何改进客户支持
大家好，我们开会决定试行聊天机器人还是延长晚间服务时间。请提前查看成本和响应时间对比；我邀请运营负责人作决定，并请支持负责人和 API 分析师提供意见。会议结束时我们会明确负责人和下一步。
rewrite.pattern: Could we meet to decide [decision]? Please review [material] before [meeting]. We’ll leave with [owner] and [next step].

cloze.prompt: Could we meet to ___ whether to pilot the chatbot?
cloze.why: 会议目标应写成要作出的决定。

cloze.prompt: Please review the comparison ___ the meeting.
cloze.why: 会前说明准备时间，帮助参会者做好准备。

cloze.prompt: We’ll leave with an owner and next ___.
cloze.why: 会议结束时明确负责人和后续行动。

dictation.text: Before you reflexively schedule a virtual meeting, make sure it’s for the 3d’s—important decisions, debates, and discussion.
Then quickly summarize the decision you made, what happens next, and who will do what.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能开会决定是否试行聊天机器人吗？
translationPractice.answer: Could we meet to decide whether to pilot a chatbot?
translationPractice.why: 用 to decide 明确会议目的。

translationPractice.prompt: 请在周四会议前查看成本对比。
translationPractice.answer: Please review the cost comparison before Thursday’s meeting.

translationPractice.prompt: 会议结束时，我们会明确试点负责人和下一步。
translationPractice.answer: We’ll leave with an owner and next step for the pilot.
translationPractice.why: 会后落到负责人和行动。

choice.prompt: 你要决定是否延长客户支持的晚间服务，运营负责人拍板，支持负责人提供数据。哪封邀请最完整？
options: Let’s meet next week to talk about support. I’ll invite everyone so no one misses the conversation.

Could we meet to decide whether to extend evening support? Please review the response-time summary beforehand. I’ll invite the operations lead to decide and the support lead to advise; we’ll leave with an owner and next step.
Please read the response-time summary. We can decide the meeting goal and attendees once we start.
choice.why: B 写明决定、会前材料、必要参会者及会后行动；A 目标空泛且过度邀请，C 把目标和参会筛选拖到会中。

output.prompt: 迁移情境：产品团队需决定是否把新客户入职培训改成直播。支持主管提供常见问题数据，培训负责人作决定，其他员工会后看纪要。请写一封简短会议邀请：提出决定问题，写出会前材料，说明必要参会者，并写明会后会安排负责人和下一步。
output.sample: Could we meet to decide whether to deliver the new-customer onboarding session live? Please review the FAQ summary beforehand. I’ll invite the support lead to advise and the training lead to decide; we’ll leave with an owner and next step.
check: 是否把会议目标写成一个明确决定？
是否要求参会者提前查看指定材料？
是否只邀请提供意见或作决定的人？
是否说明会后要明确负责人和下一步？
